AlternateTargets: return home by way of the road
Senses.Explanation: As a public Chan appraisal, ‘take the road home’ judges a person or saying by the homeward-road image. The records apply and contest the verdict in encounters; this sense does not silently absorb an ordinary physical journey. Literally the phrase says ‘take the road and return home.’
Senses.Note: No single master-specific sense is warranted. The phrase occurs across many late records, often with “turn around and return to the father” or the reversed “leave home and take the road.” The article reports those textual relations without assigning a spiritual force to “home.”

Occurrences.Kwic: 直饒說箇回途得妙，就路還家，便是千里萬里。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)). (五燈全書)(第34卷-第120卷). Full six-rung exact-turn review identifies Shiyu Mingfang as the exact headword-bearing speaker, author, or grammatical actor for this occurrence.

Occurrences.Kwic: 此是故鄉景象，若肯就路還家，便得轉身歸父。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (無異元來禪師廣錄). Wuyi Yuanlai's Extended Record, sermon at Boshan Nengren monastery; an exact pairing with “turn around and return to the father.”

Occurrences.Kwic: 一人就路還家，一人離家就路。離家就路，寸步不曾移；就路還家，通身無影像。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: (古雪哲禪師語錄). Full six-rung exact-turn review identifies Guxue Zhe as the exact headword-bearing speaker, author, or grammatical actor for this occurrence.

Occurrences.Kwic: 因機利物，就路還家，此是杖人尋常活計；到處稱尊，遇緣作主，此是杖人本分宗風。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: (天界覺浪盛禪師語錄). Full six-rung exact-turn review identifies Juelang Daosheng as the exact headword-bearing speaker, author, or grammatical actor for this occurrence.

Occurrences.Kwic: 所以一切諸佛遞代相承，修諸苦行，設諸方便，應病與藥，拔楔抽釘，喚醒痴狂，就路還家。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (青城竹浪生禪師語錄). The headword occurs in continuous direct hall discourse in Qingcheng Zhulang’s own record.

Senses.Explanation: In ordinary narrative use, the phrase describes a physical homeward journey: setting out on the road and returning home. This is a different event from the Chan appraisal idiom retained in the primary sense.
Senses.Note: No single master-specific sense is warranted. The phrase occurs across many late records, often with “turn around and return to the father” or the reversed “leave home and take the road.” The article reports those textual relations without assigning a spiritual force to “home.”

Occurrences.Kwic: 離金澤，跨船舷，也是就路還家；過嘉興，由崇德，也是就路還家；到塘棲，入佛日，登戒錄，要羯磨，也是就路還家。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: (石雨禪師法檀). Full six-rung exact-turn review identifies Shiyu Mingfang as the exact headword-bearing speaker, author, or grammatical actor for this occurrence.
